decisions.reason: Changing the inaugural issue month from November to December does not alter the author-name, author-photo identity, source, or placement requirements.
The issue-month change does not alter the required polished, modern, Civic Lantern-aligned visual style.
Moving the issue to December does not change the requirement to enhance low-quality publication images when necessary.
The source decision changes publication timing, not the Civic Lantern website as the source of article content.
The shift to a December issue does not change the requirement that advertisements render clearly without blurriness.
The publication-month change does not alter article category labels, their placement, allowed categories, or established article mappings.
Changing the issue month does not alter the rules for avoiding empty article-ending space or using visual filler elements.
The source decision does not remove or replace any of the articles required for consistency with the cover.
The issue still requires assembly from the supplied content using the latest Flat Plan; only its publication month changed.
Moving the inaugural issue to December does not change the requirement to create its magazine layout template.
The source decision does not withdraw or change the supplied tribute page or its placement toward the end of the magazine.
The issue-month change does not alter the required circular shape or reduced size of author photos.
